title: Thread per-definition payoutTable through the microgame contract into SessionStateMachine payouts
description: Follow-up filed from rev-t051 MEDIUM-2 on TASK-051. SessionStateMachine currently applies [ASSUMED] session-default payouts on regular round ends (GDD §6.1: competitive {6,4,2,1}, coop {4}/{1}; doc at SessionStateMachine.cs ~95-116) because no per-definition content is threaded through the FSM — the doc says "a follow-up once content is threaded through" and this ticket is that named owner. Work: extend the v2 microgame/content path (MicrogameDefinition payoutTable per Annex D.2 POCOs / GDD §11 schema, through IMicrogame or SetActiveMicrogame) so each round's payout comes from the active definition, falling back to the GDD §6.1 defaults when a definition omits it. Preserve: coop-vs-competitive detection via ResultKind, climax-skips-regular-payout, pot conservation, zero-alloc Tick-path discipline. Existing TASK-051 pot/stakes tests pin the default path; new tests pin the per-definition override path.
acceptance_criteria: A per-definition payoutTable (GDD §11 schema / Annex D.2 POCO field) reaches SessionStateMachine's round-end payout application for the active microgame, replacing the session-wide default when present.
Definitions without a payoutTable fall back to the GDD §6.1 defaults exactly as today (existing TASK-051 pot tests stay green unmodified).
Tests pin the override path: a non-default payoutTable changes CaptureResult payouts accordingly for competitive and coop rounds; climax rounds still skip regular payout.
The [ASSUMED] default-payout paragraph in SessionStateMachine's class doc is updated to describe the fallback-only role and drops the unowned-follow-up wording.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: RIDER (from rev-t051's TASK-051 re-verify, LOW residual, non-blocking): add one seed-threading discrimination test to the FSM scoring path while touching this surface. Gap: no suite test pins that SessionStateMachine threads ITS _scoringSeed into BonusStarDraw.Draw — a refactor passing a constant instead would keep the whole suite green (TASK-037 pins Draw's seed-sensitivity at unit level only; TASK-051's determinism tests pin same-seed-same-result, not different-seed-different-result through the FSM). Fix shape (per rev-t051, ~5 min): using the existing RunWith test helper, run (rngSeed:1, sessionSeed:777) vs (rngSeed:1, sessionSeed:778) via the explicit-seed constructor overload (f04e2cc) and assert the (First, Second) bonus-star pair differs — deterministic, seeds pickable to guarantee distinct combos since all holders are -1 in that fixture and only the combo pick varies.

comments.author: dev-t101
comments.body:
Hand-off. Two commits on master, strict tdd order: 64a9df4 test(core) RED (genuine compile-time red: error CS1739 "The best overload for 'SetActiveMicrogame' does not have a parameter named 'payoutTable'", 5 occurrences at SessionStateMachineTests.cs:972/993/1013/1037/1077) -> 3d704d2 feat(core). Baseline 554 (unchanged by 045 doc fix); final 559/559 (554+5).

DESIGN CALL (flagged for review; documented on SetActiveMicrogame's doc comment): additive optional int[] payoutTable = null trailing parameter on the EXISTING SetActiveMicrogame (backward-compatible with every call site — why AC2's TASK-051 pot tests needed zero changes). Rejected: (a) extending V2.IMicrogame (touches every v2 mechanic's contract for one field); (b) threading the whole MicrogameDefinitionV2 (couples the FSM to Barcade.Core.Content; verb/duration/difficultyMult already flow through this method's parameters). Raw int[] is the minimal shape; a future ticket can widen the channel.

AC1: CaptureResult applies _activePayoutTable when set — passed to PayoutRules.ApplyCompetitive for ranked (its ValidateTable already enforces 4-entry shape); indexed [success, fail] for coop with a NEW length==2 check (ApplyCoop takes a single int; TASK-050's validated shape convention cited by value — the validator's consts are private). AC2: TASK-051 pot/stakes tests untouched, green. AC3: ClimaxRound_IgnoresPayoutTable_NoRegularPayoutApplied uses a distinctive {100,90,80,70} climax table + independently-recomputed FinalWager.Resolve from pre-climax coins — no leak. AC4: class-doc para + CaptureResult doc rewritten — §6.1 defaults now described fallback-only, TASK-052 named as delivered.

MUTATION CHECKS (against this exact diff): competitive-override-ignored -> RegularRound_CompetitivePayoutTable_OverridesSessionDefault red (expected 10, was 6); coop-override short-circuited -> all three coop tests red (incl. wrong-length-throws expecting null instead of exception); climax-applies-unconditionally -> climax test red (expected 6, was 141 — huge table leaking). Each reverted immediately after capturing red; 559/559 clean before every real commit.

Zero-alloc: payoutTable field is a reference assignment in SetActiveMicrogame (once per round); CaptureResult's read allocates nothing new.
